newsitem.title: CANADA: ARC Energy to buy properties for C$61.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: ARC Energy to buy properties for C$61.5 mln.

text.p: Arc Energy Trust said it has entered into an agreement to acquire a package of nine major and 25 minor producing oil and gas properties in Alberta and Saskatchewan for C$61.5 million.

Arc said current production from the properties is approximately 1800 barrels of oil equivalent per day comprised of 1200 barrels per day of oil and natural gas liquids and six million cubic feet per day of natural gas.
The net cash flow generated by the properties in 1996 was approximately C$10 million including ARTC.

The reserves attributed to the properties by the independent engineering firm of Gilbert Laustsen Jung Associates Ltd, are 9.6 million barrels of oil equivalent on a proved plus probable basis, with a reserve life index of 14.5 years.

The company did not say who it planned to buy the properties from, but that they were located primarily in West Central Alberta and the Peace River Arch areas and would provide an excellent geographic fit with ARC Energy Trust's existing assets.
The effective date of the acquisition is January 1, 1997, but is conditional on entering into a formal purchase and sale agreement and certain other conditions.
